title: ItipEffector
description: ITIP base Archetype for Effector — a Structure's outbound causal port. Inherits gsm/Effector through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Effector statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Effector, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
